title: Canary synthesis and graceful fallback automation
creator: Sofia Chen
background: We need a standardized, SLO-driven canary orchestration layer that synthesizes multiple health signals into a single pass/fail decision and triggers a coordinated graceful fallback when a canary degrades. Current ad-hoc canaries live in multiple repos, lack consistent signal weighting, and require manual rollback decisions. This work ties versioning and LTS channels into rollout policies so upgrades across Hosted/Dedicated/Private deployments follow consistent safety envelopes.
description: Deliver a reusable canary synthesis service and a fallback automation harness that: 1) consumes metrics and traces across infra (latency P50/P95/P99, error rates, model-quality regression signals, CPU/GPU memory pressure, queue depth), 2) computes a composite health score against configurable policy, 3) runs percent-traffic ramps with time and metric windows, and 4) executes automated mitigation (traffic divert, model variant fallback, circuit-breaker) while creating audit logs and Slack/Console alerts. Integrate with release versioning and LTS channel metadata so the same policy can be applied to minor/patch/LTS upgrades.
acceptance_criteria: Canary orchestrator accepts a YAML policy describing signals, weights, thresholds, and ramp schedule
Composite health score computed and stored per cohort with retention for 30 days
Automated rollback or graceful fallback executed without human intervention when policy fails
Dashboard shows per-cohort score, signal breakdown, and decision history
End-to-end integration tests that simulate transient and sustained degradations pass
Playbook generated and validated with SRE runbook exercises (tabletop + one live drill)
tasks: Design policy DSL for canary synthesis (weights, windows, ramp curves, automatic mitigation actions)
Implement metrics adapter to normalize signals from metrics-ingest, tracing, and model-quality pipeline
Build canary-orchestration microservice with stateless decision engine and durable audit log
Add rollout controller in deployment infra to perform incremental traffic shifts and cohort assignment
Create fallbacks: model-variant swap, region routing, and capacity tier downgrade
Expose decision API and integrate with Console for visualization and manual override
Write end-to-end simulator to run thousands of ramp scenarios and validate decision thresholds
Create canary dashboard and alerting rules in Grafana/Alerts for on-call
Author runbook and run tabletop exercises with SRE and PM teams
Implement integration tests and add to CI gating for runtime-1.x releases

risks: Signal poisoning: bad telemetry could cause false rollbacks — mitigated by adding signal-health checks and voting logic
Overly aggressive automation might cause cascading fallbacks — mitigated via staged mitigations and cooldown windows
Compatibility across Private deployments with limited telemetry visibility — mitigated by pluggable signal adapters and degrade-to-manual mode
testing_plan: Unit tests for policy parser and score computation
Simulator-based regression tests that sweep across noise, step-failure, and slow-drift patterns
Chaos experiments in a staging cluster to validate mitigations under partial outage
Integration tests that run full ramp and rollback flows in CI using mocked metrics and real deployment controller

runbook_snippet: If composite score < configured threshold during ramp: 1) Pause ramp immediately; 2) Notify on-call; 3) Execute first mitigation (traffic-divert to previous stable) and wait for cooldown window; 4) If score remains low after mitigation, escalate and run full rollback
Manual override: Console > Rollouts > Select cohort > Force Pause or Force Rollback (requires two-phase approval for Dedicated customers)
Post-incident: Attach decision audit log to the incident ticket and run the standard regression checklist
notes_for_assignee: Prioritize building the policy DSL and metrics adapter first. Coordinate with Console team for the visualization API. Run the simulator early to calibrate default weights before enabling auto-rollback for any LTS channel.
